lines.en: One step of mine snaps two trees.
My long neck rises over the canopy.

lines.zh: 地面在我的重量下往下陷。
lines.en: The ground sags under my weight.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过丛林，叶都被压平。
lines.en: I cross the jungle; leaves flatten.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫开一片灌木。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a patch of brush aside.
I lift one leg, then set it down.
My steps sound far away.
I go around a pool.
I am not fast. I am large.
I look down at the path from high up.
I reach for the highest leaves.
I chew slowly, a great deal at once.
A bird lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我在听林子深处的声音。
lines.en: I listen deep into the wood.
When I move, the whole canopy sways.
A layer of leaves has settled on me.
I blink, slow and heavy.
This place is far too small for me.
I lift a leg and hold it.
I lower my head and sniff the treetops.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上拖出痕。
lines.en: My tail scores the ground.

lines.zh: 远处的河声，我记在心里。
lines.en: I remember the sound of the distant river.
I raise my head. The clouds move.
My shadow covers a stretch of forest.
I need hide from nothing.
I must bend down to look at you.
Your bow will not pierce my hide.
You cannot bear one of my steps.

lines.zh: 我从上面看下来，你很小。
lines.en: I look down. You are small.
The whole jungle is barely room to turn.
Get outside the trees.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，我全听见了。
lines.en: I heard every twig you snapped.
Do not disturb me.
Your weapon is raised.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，你看见了吗。
lines.en: Do you see where I have trodden?
Back out slowly.
A mark on my hide.

lines.zh: 长脖子转过来，我盯住伤口。
lines.en: My long neck turns; I stare at the wound.
That little pain scarce concerns me.
A few drops of blood on the ground.
I give a low bellow.
I knocked a tree over.
I am still standing.
I do not run.
The topmost leaves are out of reach.
Raise that bundle higher.
I can eat a whole thicket in one go.
Put it on the rock.
This is far too little.
Bring some more.
I never eat meat.
Stay ten paces back.
The leaves on this tree are good.
I reach over slowly.
You only hit one of my toes.
I felt nothing.
Get clear. My feet are blind.
I am shifting position.
My leg is taller than you.
Make way.
That bump is beneath my notice.
My tail scraped you.
Stand further off.
I cannot be bothered to dodge.

lines.zh: 这片林子里只有我一头。
lines.en: I am the only one of my kind in this wood.
Such things are very rare.
I only want to eat in peace.

lines.zh: 我连自己的同伴都找不到。
lines.en: I cannot even find my own kind.
Do not ask such things.
Best step aside.
That topic does not fit me.
I am off into the trees.
A fruit fell from the tree.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，两百五十点。
lines.en: This body carries two hundred fifty.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很大，抓不住小的。
lines.en: My mouth is large; small things slip.
I take the branch with it.
This tiny bit is too little.
I cannot see things on the ground well.

lines.zh: 那么小的东西，我用鼻子拱开。
lines.en: Something so small; I nudge it aside with my nose.
These are yours.
You are right at my feet.
I have lowered my head.
This time I am not eating grass.

lines.zh: 树冠一晃，我低下头找你。
lines.en: The canopy sways; I lower my head to find you.
I raise a foreleg.
The trees are too thick for you to run.
This ground will shake.
Three breaths.
Which way will you run?
My tail is already raised.
I turn, ponderous.
I am setting off.
Do not stand directly below.
I take one step toward you.
Trees break beside me.
You have backed under my feet.
I lower my neck to look at you.
My leg is still raised.
Wind passes over the canopy.
You are struggling to run.
One more breath of waiting.
I am coming down.
The tail is coming.
There is no open ground here.
In this one breath.
I have pressed down.
Loud, is it not?
It is not over yet.
My foreleg stamps down.
My tail sweeps a wide arc.
I headbutt a tree and it falls.
My neck sweeps across you.
The ground splits under me.
My forefoot lands and the ground shakes.
That one throws up the soil.
You roll against a root.
That weighs more than arrows.
I turn slowly for another.
Leaves come down everywhere.
My tail sweeps back.
You are knocked a stretch away.
I rise through the canopy.
The whole jungle shakes.
I have pushed the trees down.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了这一片。
lines.en: My shadow covers this stretch.
Every bird has risen.
I look out between the crowns.
This place is much smaller than I.
I have packed down a patch of ground.
Someone has woken me.
Deep prints remain in the ground.
I smell leaves.

lines.zh: 丛林一静，我抬起长脖子。
lines.en: The jungle goes quiet; I raise my long neck.
I turn my neck.
Now it is finally quiet.
I lower my neck.
One step of mine and you will know.
I have set foot in this wood.

lines.zh: 火燎在我皮上，很快就灭。
lines.en: Fire on my hide, soon gone.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，整片林子都响。
lines.en: I land from a height and the wood echoes.
The water only reaches half my leg.
The blast bursts only at my feet.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我皮上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hide like a thorn.
This light is brighter than leaves.
There are not enough leaves up there.

lines.zh: 这么重的身体，下坠得很快。
lines.en: A body this heavy falls fast.
